method: A second agent with no prior task context inspected only the original embedded raster; its boxes independently support the source geometry. The primary annotator had earlier exposure to application output; this is a retrospective validation.
resolution_decision: Retain the primary annotation rule requiring the chosen closed contour to span at least 1 hour and 1 dB. The narrow early/late innermost loops are below that resolution; primary source boxes use the next resolvable closed enclosure. Secondary reviewer identified late innermost loop as tentative due to black-dot occlusion. The main daytime boxes agree within about four pixels.
